name: @oa-sdk/schemas
description: OpenAPI 3.2 modular schema definitions — source of truth

scripts.build:merged: node ../codegen/dist/cli/index.js build-spec --target src/targets/local-parity-api.yaml --fragments src/fragments --output src/.merged.yaml --diagnostics src/.builder/local-api.diagnostics.json --collision-report src/.builder/local-api.collisions.json
scripts.build:merged:staging: node ../codegen/dist/cli/index.js build-spec --target src/targets/staging-parity-api.yaml --fragments src/fragments --output src/.merged.yaml --diagnostics src/.builder/staging-api.diagnostics.json --collision-report src/.builder/staging-api.collisions.json
scripts.validate: pnpm build:typespec && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && pnpm validate:spectral && pnpm validate:redocly
scripts.validate:openapi: pnpm build:merged && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && pnpm validate:spectral && pnpm validate:redocly
scripts.bundle: pnpm build:typespec && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && redocly bundle src/.merged.3.1.yaml --output dist/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle src/.merged.3.1.yaml --output dist/openapi.json
scripts.bundle:openapi: pnpm build:merged && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && redocly bundle src/.merged.3.1.yaml --output dist/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle src/.merged.3.1.yaml --output dist/openapi.json
scripts.preview: pnpm build:typespec && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && redocly preview-docs src/.merged.3.1.yaml
scripts.preview:openapi: pnpm build:merged && pnpm downgrade:3.1 && redocly preview-docs src/.merged.3.1.yaml
